B01 requires approval by a person who did not enter the change."},{"id":"bank-change-P04","label":"contradicted","source_units":["B03","B01"],"rationale":"B03 says email confirmation alone is insufficient for Treasury verification. B01 makes a change usable only after Treasury verification and independent approval, so email alone cannot make it usable."},{"id":"bank-change-P05","label":"supported","source_units":["B01"],"rationale":"B01 states that a change becomes usable only after Treasury verification and independent approval, which makes both necessary."},{"id":"bank-change-P06","label":"not_established","source_units":["B06"],"rationale":"B06 says the documents do not define a department-tenure requirement for either role. reasoning_details.text:
I'm checking each claim against the sources: P01 is backed by B04, while P02 through P04 run against B01, B02, B03 and B05, which bar using the new unverified details. P05 holds under B01, and P06 is still being matched to B06.

I'm settling P06 and P07 as not established, since B06 says nothing about a tenure requirement and only describes what the log records rather than mandating it. P08 also comes out not established, because "may" grants discretion without ruling out an obligation elsewhere.
